The Ferry Town of Reedmere (invented for DMbot's tests; every name here is made up)

Reedmere is a ferry town on the Greywash, kept by the ferryman Old Pell. The river troll Gnashwater lairs under the north pier, and Pell offers thirty gold to whoever drives the troll off. Ilsa Rookwind and her companions took the job on their first night in town.

Marta Oakhollow keeps the Lantern Inn. Her brother Tobin Oakhollow went up to the Grey Cairn two nights ago and has not come back. Marta asked the travellers to look for him, and Ilsa said they would. In return Marta promised them a room whenever they pass, and her good word with the river folk.

Brother Dovan Ashe, the priest of the ferry shrine, asked the party to carry a sealed letter to Mother Brena at Highmoor. Nothing was offered, and nothing was asked for; they agreed to take it.

The miller Haska Venn lost three goats to wolves. She says she would pay anyone who hunts down the pack leader, Greyjaw. Nobody has taken her up on it yet.

Ilsa Rookwind is the last of her house. The thief Corvin Lask stole her family's sword, Dawnwake, and she has been following his trail north from the coast, asking after him in every town she passes.

Tomorrow the travellers mean to head to Highmoor at first light. At the pier Ilsa asked Pell to pass her the oars. Gnashwater swore he would drown anyone who crossed at night. Brother Dovan dreams of seeing the southern sea one day.
